descriptions.zh: 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[获取智能任务结果](~~441172~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en: This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). When you submit a job, the API returns a job ID. The system then queues the job for background processing and sends the final result via a callback notification. You can also query the job status by calling the [Get Smart Task Result](~~441172~~) operation.
